title: Play-to-Earn Gaming and How Work is Evolving in Web3

reader_summary.headline: Welcome to the A16D podcast, I'm Zorin.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome to the A16D podcast, I'm Zorin. Today we're talking about an emerging model of gaming called Play to Earn. Play-to-earn is also part of broader trends, the changing relationship between players and platforms, new incentives for participants in blockchain-based networks.

key_points.text: Today we're talking about an emerging model of gaming called Play to Earn.
key_points.evidence_quote: Today we're talking about an emerging model of gaming called Play to Earn, in which players can make actual money based on how much time and effort they put into a game, not from streaming revenue for top players or e-sports, but day-to-day gameplay.

key_points.text: Play-to-earn is also part of broader trends, the changing relationship between players and platforms, new incentives for participants in blockchain-based networks.
key_points.evidence_quote: Play-to-earn is also part of broader trends, the changing relationship between players and platforms, new incentives for participants in blockchain-based networks, and the new internet era that is coming to be known as Web3.

key_points.text: The top play-to-earned game is called Axi Infinity.
key_points.evidence_quote: The top play-to-earned game is called Axi Infinity.

key_points.text: It's operated, by a Vietnam-based company called Sky Mavis.
